Anya (Design): Quick design review — pushing updated Create API Key modal to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Main asks: default expiry choice, the 'Show secret' affordance, inline role scope checklist order, and the warning copy when choosing long-lived keys. Short answers pls, aiming to ship a small polish tomorrow.

Sam C (Product): Looking now. My initial thought: default should be 90 days (security best-practice). If we keep 'Never' visible, it should be de-emphasized (secondary action). Also we need a stronger warning copy when admin scope + never expiry is selected.

Kevin (Eng): Implementation notes: we can change the default in the new UI only (no db migration). Important: don't render the secret value in the DOM until user clicks Reveal — return ephemeral value from backend and mount it client-side only then. Copy-to-clipboard tooltip should say "Copied" and disappear; use a11y announcement for screen readers.

Liz (Accessibility): A few a11y nits: 1) The eye toggle needs explicit aria-labels that change: `Reveal API key` / `Hide API key` (not just "Show"). 2) Use `aria-live="polite"` for copy confirmation text so NVDA/VoiceOver announce it. 3) The warning paragraph should be referenced by `aria-describedby` from the expiry control so keyboard users get context. 4) Ensure tab order: role scope checklist should come before expiry dropdown so keyboard users can choose scopes then expiry.

Anya (Design): Proposed wording options: - Expiry label: "Key expiry (recommended)" with default option text "90 days" - Warning copy when selecting Never: "This key will not expire. Long‑lived keys increase potential exposure if leaked. Rotate regularly and limit scopes." Trying to keep it short. Thoughts?

Sam C (Product): Prefer the proposed warning but tweak to: "This key will not expire. Long‑lived keys increase potential exposure if leaked — rotate regularly and limit scopes." (swap 'increase potential exposure' ok). Also make the Never option less visually prominent (lighter color) and add a confirmation checkbox when Admin + Never selected: "I understand this key will never expire."

Kevin (Eng): Confirmation checkbox is doable. UX+backend: if user confirms, we still log an event and add a note on the key object. For the reveal button, sample implementation suggestion: `<button class="reveal" aria-label="Reveal API key" aria-pressed="false">👁️</button>` on click fetch ephemeral secret, set `aria-pressed="true"` and replace content. Also: avoid `value` attr on inputs for the secret; set innerText only when revealed.

Liz (Accessibility): Small correction: use `aria-pressed` only if it's a true toggle; this is more of a reveal action (not persistent state) so better to use `aria-expanded`? Either way, explicit `aria-label` that changes is critical. Also ensure the confirmation checkbox has clear label and `aria-describedby` linking to the warning copy.

Kevin (Eng): Good point — we can do `aria-expanded` or just change aria-label. I'll follow Liz's final call.

Anya (Design): OK I'll update Figma: de-emphasize 'Never', default 90d, add confirmation checkbox for Admin+Never, move role checklist above expiry, and update warning copy per Sam. I'll post updated screenshot tomorrow morning. @Liz can you do a quick keyboard walkthrough after I update? :thumbsup:

Liz (Accessibility): Yep — will verify keyboard + screen reader flow once you post.

deploy-bot: Archived older thread 1834567890-revoke-undo-cta-flow-proposal for context.

Anya (Design): thanks all — small follow-up Q: for the reveal tooltip, should we include expiry time in the copied confirmation (e.g., "Copied — expires in 90 days") or keep it generic?

Sam C (Product): Include expiry if it's not Never. If Never, keep it generic: "Copied" + maybe a tiny hint: "This key does not expire." but keep it unobtrusive.

Kevin (Eng): We'll include expiry in the tooltip if available. For screen readers, announce expiry via `aria-live` when revealed.

Anya (Design): Cool. I'll iterate and ping again. :sparkles!
